core_obligations: Reduce and identify the tangent spaces (proof lines 7610-7620): by the elementary properties one may replace the category by its associated category in sets; both tangent spaces carry their natural vector space structures, and unwinding the construction of the change of residue field gives the chain of equalities identifying the tangent space of the changed category with the tensor product of the original tangent space with the residue field extension.

Extend to finite dimensional vector spaces (proof lines 7620-7628): more generally, for a finite dimensional l-vector space V the value of the changed category on the trivial extension by V equals the tensor product of the tangent space with V viewed over the smaller field, so that the two functors of V are canonically identified as functors to sets.

Conclude compatibility (proof lines 7628-7630): since a functor to sets admits at most one structure of a linear functor, the identifications are compatible with the l-vector space structures, giving the required canonical isomorphism of tangent spaces.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the associated category in sets and unwind the definitions to identify the tangent space of the changed category.
Generalize the identification to the trivial extensions by finite dimensional vector spaces.
Use uniqueness of a linear structure to upgrade the identification to a linear isomorphism.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a predeformation category whose associated category in sets satisfies (S2), the change of residue field of its tangent space is canonically isomorphic to the tangent space of the changed category (statement lines 7598-7608). The proof (proof lines 7610-7632) reduces to the associated category in sets, unwinds the definitions to identify the tangent spaces and their generalization to finite dimensional coefficient spaces, and applies the uniqueness of a linear structure. H2: a two-step identification with three inputs, written out in full.
